[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | value = 30 {{gold}} | campaign = [[Nightfall]] | commonsalvage = 4-5 [[Bolt of Cloth|Bolts of Cloth]] | raresalvage = 2 [[Roll of Parchment|Rolls of Parchment]] }} [[Mummy Wrapping]]s are pieces of torn-off wrapping left behind by slain [[Awakened]]. ==Acquisition== *[[Nightfall]] **[[Awakened Acolyte]] **[[Awakened Blademaster]] **[[Awakened Cavalier]] **[[Awakened Defiler]] **[[Awakened Dune Carver]] **[[Awakened Gray Giant]] **[[Awakened Thought Leech]] ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Mummy Wrapping#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== From [[Bone Palace]] head into [[Joko's Domain]] and take out the groups in the sand immediately outside. Head East off of the sand and take out the two groups on the granite to the north, then head directly south for more groups on the granite there. [[Desert Wurm]]s will spawn with some groups. This run hits 8 - 10 groups and can be completed in about 20 minutes. [[Margonites]] can be found along the way - pick up the bounty from the [[Ghostly Priest]] just outside of Bone Palace for some [[Lightbringer Points]]. ==Collectors== {{:Rahvu/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|7th February 2011 and 14th April 2014|The Sulfurous Wastes|3 [[Mummy Wrapping]]s}}
